items.title: LR2 fleet: fewer than a quarter of 542 ships now carry clean cargoes
items.summary: Signal Ocean data cited by Bloomberg show a record three-quarters of large product tankers are carrying crude, and LR2s' share of refined-product trade fell to 12% in Q3 from almost 18% a year earlier. The LR2 fleet has grown 12% since January 2025; RBC estimates about 1.7m b/d of more than 9m b/d of Middle East refining capacity is offline, about 1m b/d of it needing months of repairs.

items.title: Chemical tanker Med Emre sinks off Ibiza with about 7,000 t of diesel; one seafarer dead
items.summary: The Malta-flagged, 2019-built 8,270 dwt chemical tanker sank off Ibiza while carrying around 7,000 tonnes of diesel, and one crew member died. A pollution response is under way; the cause has not been reported.

items.title: BIMCO issues tanker clause putting STS transfer costs and risks on charterers
items.summary: BIMCO has published a new standard clause for tanker charter parties that assigns the costs and risks of ship-to-ship cargo transfers to charterers, while keeping the master's authority over vessel safety.

items.title: Kpler: 44m bbl of Iranian oil afloat on 37 tankers; AIS signal shows spoofing
items.summary: Kpler counts about 44m bbl of Iranian crude and condensate on 37 tankers (16 VLCCs, 12 suezmaxes, 6 aframaxes, 3 MRs) and no Iranian export loadings since Aug 24 under the US blockade. It found the AIS identity of KHAT SHEKAN matching the chemical tanker STOLT BOBCAT (IMO 9511167), and counted five STS transfers of about 1.9m bbl on Nov 12–18. Kpler recorded 16 Hormuz attacks in November through Nov 20.

items.title: EU proposes ban on Russian-insured tankers in 22nd sanctions package
items.summary: European Commission President von der Leyen outlined on Nov 23 a package that would bar tankers insured in Russia, stop EU firms from servicing Russian energy infrastructure including refineries, and add more than 70 vessels to the shadow-fleet list. It needs unanimous approval from all 27 member states. S&P data showed no oil or chemical tankers discharging in the Netherlands in November carried Russian cover.

items.title: Week 47: Baltic clean index 2,581; one-year MR charter $34,000/day
items.summary: Compass Maritime's Nov 23 report puts the Baltic Clean Tanker Index at 2,581, against 2,592 a week earlier and 811 a year ago, while the dirty index rose to 5,081 from 4,483. Its one-year time-charter assessment for MRs eased to $34,000/day from $36,500, with LR1s unchanged at $53,500 and VLCCs down to $184,500 from $234,000.

items.title: 15-year-old VLCC valued at $165m, about 25% above a newbuild
items.summary: Using CMB.Tech and Clarksons data, gCaptain reports a 15-year-old VLCC at $165m against $132m for a newbuild and a 10-year average of $46m for that age. VLCC spot earnings were $149,945/day in Q3 (vs $30,486 a year earlier); round voyages average 23 days against an optimal 9–10, and the orderbook is 33.1% of the fleet.

items.title: ADNOC L&S confirms death of crew member missing after Nov 17 Hormuz attack
items.summary: ADNOC Logistics & Services said a Jordanian seafarer, unaccounted for since an attack on one of its vessels in the Strait of Hormuz on Nov 17, has been found dead. Eleven crew were injured; nine have been discharged and two remain in care.

items.title: Abu Dhabi restricts tanker movements over Gulf security
items.summary: Splash247 reports that Abu Dhabi has placed restrictions on tanker movements as security concerns in the Gulf grow. Details of the measures were not available in the material reviewed.

items.title: Houthis target Saudi Red Sea ports; projectile hits Jazan with minor damage
items.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said a Houthi projectile struck Jazan port on Nov 25, causing minor damage and no civilian injuries, and a drone was intercepted near Jeddah Islamic Port. On Nov 26 Saudi forces reported intercepting two ballistic missiles aimed at Riyadh, a cruise missile toward the western region and drones over the Eastern Province. The Houthis describe the strikes as retaliation for coalition attacks on Hodeidah.

items.title: Gulf: two tanker incidents off the UAE on Nov 25; crews safe
items.summary: UKMTO logged an explosion, believed to be an unidentified projectile, about 50 nm west of Dubai at 21:30 GMT on Nov 25; the tanker, not named, reported no damage. Separately, a Liberia-flagged tanker was hit about 14 nm northwest of Ras Al Khaimah, causing an engine-room fire; all 22 crew were reported safe.

items.title: Red Sea and Indian Ocean states move toward a combined maritime task force
items.summary: Signatories to the Djibouti Code of Conduct and Jeddah Amendment adopted a regional maritime security strategy at a Nov 11–13 meeting in Antananarivo and agreed to advance a Combined Maritime Task Force, the IMO said. The legal framework and concept of operations are to be developed in 2027; no deployment timeline or naval assets have been announced.

items.title: Maersk and ONE reported to be discussing a north–south vessel-sharing deal
items.summary: The Loadstar, citing unnamed sources, reports that Maersk and Ocean Network Express are working on a global north–south vessel-sharing agreement; neither carrier had commented. Maersk holds 16.1% and ONE 9% of weekly Far East–West Coast South America capacity.

items.title: Lower Mississippi at New Orleans: safety zone in place through Dec 11
items.summary: The Coast Guard has set a one-mile safety zone (mile 95.5–96.5) for salvage of the capsized cruise vessel American Heritage, struck by the asphalt tanker Atlantic Asphalt on Nov 13. Limited two-way traffic is allowed through the Crescent City Connection main span, but deep-draft ships and tows of 10 or more barges move one-way; the alternate channel remains closed.

items.title: Wednesday Nov 25 close: Dow 50,182.95 (+0.33%), S&P 500 7,182.78 (−0.25%), Nasdaq 23,585.80 (−0.62%)
items.summary: The Dow gained 164.25 points, the S&P 500 lost 18.31 and the Nasdaq 147.73, after indexes recovered most of a steep early decline led by chip stocks; the Russell 2000 rose 0.71% to 2,704.06. Nvidia closed down 3.9% at $149.30 after S&P Global Ratings warned of a possible downgrade. US markets are closed Thursday for Thanksgiving and reopen Friday for a shortened session.
items.source: Yahoo Finance / AP via BNN Bloomberg

items.title: Oil: Brent settles $94.61 (+3.5%), WTI $83.68 (+2.0%)
items.summary: Brent rose $3.21 and WTI $1.63 on Nov 25 after the Houthis claimed strikes on Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery and Riyadh. EIA data showed US crude stocks up 1.1 million barrels to 418.9 million in the week to Nov 20; OPEC+ meets Nov 29 to set 2027 output.

items.title: OPEC+ meets this month to set 2027 baselines after capacity audit
items.summary: OPEC+ ministers meet at the end of November to decide 2027 supply policy, using a DeGolyer and MacNaughton capacity audit whose results were given to each member on Nov 16 as the basis for targets from January. The UAE has left the group and Iraq is seeking a 6m b/d baseline. Brent fell almost 25% in November but remained about 40% above a year earlier as of Nov 24.

items.title: US natural gas: December Nymex closed $3.323/MMBtu on Nov 24
items.summary: The December contract rose 13.9 cents (4.4%) on Tuesday after falling 22.7 cents to $3.184 on Monday, per EBW Analytics. Henry Hub spot was near $3.30, and the consensus for this week's EIA storage report is a 17–25 Bcf draw.

items.title: Core PCE 3.3% in October; futures price about 98% odds of a December Fed hike
items.summary: Core PCE inflation rose to 3.3% year on year in October, above the 3.2% expected. Fed funds futures implied about a 98% chance of a 25 bp increase at the December meeting; the Beige Book noted continued cost pressures in energy, transportation, insurance and tariff-related expenses. Yahoo's quote showed the 10-year Treasury yield at 4.848%, down 5.6 bp, and Freddie Mac's 30-year mortgage average at 7.21%.

items.title: US announces new tariffs on China, EU and other partners
items.summary: The administration unveiled new tariffs of up to 20% on China, the EU and other trading partners, layered on existing rates and taking effect after a comment period, in January at the earliest. South Korean coverage says the 15% cap under the 2025 Korea–US deal remains for now.

items.title: Thursday Nov 26: Europe and Asia higher in early trade; dollar at 159.14 yen
items.summary: In early Nov 26 trading the DAX was up 1.8% at 25,131.36, the CAC 40 up 1.6% and the FTSE 100 up 1.3% at 10,563.62. The Nikkei 225 gained 0.9% to 57,499.16, the Hang Seng 1.2% and the Kospi 0.3% after a 6.2% drop on Wednesday. The euro was at $1.0975.

items.title: Zelenskyy warns Russia is preparing another major strike on energy infrastructure
items.summary: Zelenskyy said on Nov 26, citing Ukrainian intelligence, that Russia is completing preparations for a large attack on energy and logistics. Crews were restoring power in six regions after an overnight attack with ballistic missiles and 113 drones that Ukraine's air force said hit 20 locations; Russia said it intercepted 343 Ukrainian drones. Figures come from each side's officials.

items.title: Kushner says peace talks are deadlocked over territory; EU leaders meet in Brussels
items.summary: US envoy Jared Kushner said negotiations between Russia and Ukraine have reached a deadlock over Ukrainian territory and said Putin had agreed not to use nuclear weapons, a claim AP reported without confirmation. At an EU summit in Brussels, Italy's Giorgia Meloni said the war must not spread to the Mediterranean.

items.title: Israeli court urges prosecutors to reconsider main bribery case against Netanyahu
items.summary: The Jerusalem District Court panel suggested the attorney general consider dropping the most serious bribery case against Prime Minister Netanyahu and voiced doubts about a second case, while a third case over gifts of nearly $300,000 continues. The judges said their remarks are not a verdict; Netanyahu denies wrongdoing.

items.title: Kim Jong Un calls for more nuclear weapons after factory visits
items.summary: North Korean state media said Kim Jong Un inspected two nuclear-materials plants, one new and one being expanded, and called for expanding the arsenal. He did not take up President Trump's offer to meet during the recent Asia trip.

items.title: Fire at Bangchak's 120,000 b/d Bangkok refinery injures nine; output halted
items.summary: An explosion and fire at a Bangchak Corp. refinery unit in Bangkok on Nov 26 injured at least nine people, three critically. The fire was out in about an hour and production is halted; Thailand's energy minister said fuel supply should not be affected.

items.title: Merz tells Bundestag Russia poses a growing threat
items.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz defended higher defense spending and continued aid to Ukraine, telling parliament the threat from Russia is increasing. Separately, German defense officials are discussing how to offset a planned US military drawdown in Europe, according to POLITICO.

items.title: Broncos (8–2) at Steelers (6–4) Friday, 2:00 pm CT on Prime Video
items.summary: Denver entered the week tied with Kansas City at 8–2 atop the AFC West after a 38–24 win over Las Vegas on Nov 22; Pittsburgh is 4–0 at home and ESPN's preview says it will start Mason Rudolph at quarterback. ESPN lists Broncos S Taylor Rapp (quadriceps) and DE Sai'vion Jones (hamstring) out and RB J.K. Dobbins on reserve/suspension.

items.title: Texans (4–6) host Ravens (4–7) Sunday at noon CT on CBS
items.summary: Houston is second in the AFC South behind Jacksonville (7–3) and 1–4 at home after a 26–3 win over Indianapolis on Nov 19. ESPN lists WR Marvin Harrison Jr., DE Danielle Hunter (both hamstring), G Wyatt Teller, TE Brevin Jordan and RB Woody Marks (concussion) as questionable; Baltimore QB Lamar Jackson is on injured reserve.

items.title: Davis Cup: Great Britain beats Germany 2–1 to reach the semifinals
items.summary: Cameron Norrie beat Jan-Lennard Struff 6-3, 3-6, 6-2 and Alexander Zverev levelled by beating Arthur Fery 6-3, 6-2; Henry Patten and Neal Skupski then won the doubles over Krawietz and Puetz 6-2, 7-6(7). Britain plays the Austria–Spain winner on Saturday, Nov 28.

items.title: Davis Cup: Italy meets Czechia in Friday's first semifinal
items.summary: Czechia beat Canada 2–0 as Tomas Machac defeated Liam Draxl 6-2, 3-6, 6-2 and Jiri Lehecka beat Felix Auger-Aliassime 7-6(4), 6-2; Italy edged South Korea 2–1. The final in Bologna is on Sunday, Nov 29.
